result.summary: The page layout is generally sound, but there is an untranslated localization key displayed as a section heading, and an inconsistent favorite-button style between restaurant cards.

issues.description: The second section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key (and add a fallback so raw keys are never rendered).

issues.description: The heart/favorite buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use inconsistent styles: the first has a white circular background with a dark outline heart, while the second has a dark/transparent circular background with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, icon color, and size) across all restaurant cards, ideally with a consistent scrim for legibility over varied imagery.
